name: StorageFix
subtitle: Review files. Reclaim clarity.
promotionalText: See where your space goes, compare duplicate copies and review large files in folders you choose. One review queue, explicit confirmation, nothing deleted by a scan.
description:
Make room with a clearer picture of your files.

StorageFix helps you review folders you choose, understand where space is going and decide what to keep. Scans only read file information. Nothing is selected or removed for you.

A GUIDED REVIEW
Follow five steps: choose a folder, understand the results, inspect candidates, confirm your review queue and verify the outcome with a fresh scan.

EXPLORE YOUR STORAGE
Switch between a treemap, ring and two-level sunburst linked to a ranked list. Drill into folders, follow breadcrumbs, search, sort and use Quick Look. Coverage details separate logical sizes, allocated sizes where macOS reports them, shared hard links, cloud placeholders and anything that could not be read.

COMPARE DUPLICATE COPIES
Duplicate comparison is optional and checks complete file contents. Preview copies, choose which one to keep and pick extra copies yourself. Suggestions never select files.

FIND LARGE AND OLD FILES
Filter by size, type, name, path and last-modified date. Selections stay explicit when filters change.

ONE REVIEW QUEUE
Files from the map, file list and duplicates gather in one queue. The kept copy of a duplicate set is protected, every file is checked again just before it moves, and each result is reported individually. Files go to Finder Trash, where you can put them back.

HONEST OUTCOMES
After an operation, StorageFix shows the volume's measured free space before and after and lets you measure again. Space normally returns only when you empty Trash yourself. Export outcome reports as text, JSON or CSV; paths are left out unless you include them.

COMPARE SCANS OVER TIME
Use a scan as a baseline, optionally save it, rescan later and see which files appeared, disappeared or changed size.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No account, advertising, tracking, analytics or file uploads. Scan data stays on your Mac. Folder access lasts for the session you grant it.

Also includes a read-only application inventory and a personal checklist linking to macOS settings. The checklist does not inspect security configuration or detect malware.

Requires macOS 14 or later. This edition does not clean system caches, uninstall applications or permanently delete files.
whatsNew: A guided five-step review, a shared review queue with per-file outcomes and measured free space, treemap/ring/sunburst storage maps, scan comparison and faster duplicate comparison.
